import json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
node = re.compile(r'("node"\s*:\s*)"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"')
def git(ref,p): return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',ref+':'+str(p)],text=True)
def mask(s):return node.sub(r'\1"<node>"',s)
n=0
for fam in ['block','utxo','chain','finality','mempool']:
 p=Path(f'corpus/chain/{fam}/{fam}.jsonl');before=git('origin/main',p);after=p.read_text();assert mask(before)==mask(after),fam
 for a,b in zip(before.splitlines(),after.splitlines(),strict=True):
  aa=json.loads(a);bb=json.loads(b);del aa['node'];del bb['node'];assert aa==bb;n+=1
print(f'family preservation: GREEN [X] ([M] {n} rows; every non-node byte unchanged against origin/main)')
def normalize(s, triggers):
 s=mask(s)
 s=re.sub(r'measured agree \[X\] docs/records/20261013-032121-s6-66b-regtest-s3.md','pending #66',s)
 s=s.replace('`action.trigger` RPC batch','`action.trigger` oracle event')
 matches=list(re.finditer(r'"trigger":\s*',s));decoder=json.JSONDecoder()
 for m in reversed(matches):
  value,end=decoder.raw_decode(s[m.end():]);triggers.append(value);s=s[:m.end()]+'"<R2-trigger>"'+s[m.end()+end:]
 return s
for p in sorted(Path('corpus/scenarios').glob('2026*.md')):
 old=[];new=[];reviewed=[]
 assert normalize(git('origin/main',p),old)==normalize(p.read_text(),new),p
 normalize(git('9c68ee29160e7a97ccd34fb463259f97e8d0afce',p),reviewed)
 assert new==reviewed
 assert len(old)==len(new)
 assert all(t['type']=='oracleInstrumentation' for t in old)
 assert all(t['type']=='rpc' and t['rpc']=='sendrawtransactions' and t['transactions']==['sweep0','sweep1'] for t in new)
print('intake preservation: GREEN [X] ([M] 2 files; only node metadata and the reviewed R2 trigger/prose amendment)')
